    a=compare(Path(reference),before,cases);b=compare(Path(reference),after,cases)
    old={x['id'] for x in a['cases'] if x['differences']};new={x['id'] for x in b['cases'] if x['differences']}

        'repaired':sorted(old-new),'regressed':sorted(new-old),'remaining':[x for x in b['cases'] if x['differences']],
